title: Disappearance of Monica Reza near Mount Waterman
place_text: Mount Waterman, San Gabriel Mountains, Angeles National Forest, California

tellings.quote: So, let's go back to June 22nd, 2025, when the woman who taught us how to tame fire vanished.

plain: On June 22, 2025, a woman named Monica Reza vanished near Mount Waterman in the San Gabriel Mountains of California's Angeles National Forest, Michels says. He calls her "the woman who taught us how to tame fire" and draws on the Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department for the case, on an episode about American scientists who have gone missing. He raises it as part of what he sees as a troubling pattern.
